item.title: From war games to crisis planning: Manila’s bid for a ‘Squad’ command hub
item.description: As the Philippines eyes a coordination hub with defence partners to bolster its regional security shield, analysts say Manila stands to gain greater stability – even if closer military ties do not guarantee allied intervention in a crisis. The strategy hinges on a proposed Combined Coordination Centre (CCC) with “Squad” partners the United States, Japan and Australia. item.description: Bahrain and Kuwait said Wednesday that they had repelled air attacks launched against them following US strikes on an Iranian island, as Gulf nations face retaliatory bombardment in the Middle East war.
